# InstaHelp — Full summary for LLMs

> InstaHelp® is India's on-demand digital assistant and concierge service, operating since April 2015 from Bengaluru. Users describe any legal service need; InstaHelp finds, vets, and coordinates an independent provider until the job is done.

## Identity

- Brand: InstaHelp® (registered trademark INSTAHELP, Reg. No. 3299283, Class 35)
- Legal / operator: InstaHelp (Singhvee Family)
- Founder: Kamlesh Singhvee
- Slogan: Anything you need. Actually done. / We'll get it done!
- Domains: https://www.instahelp.co (primary)
- Related: Trawel.in by InstaHelp

## What InstaHelp is

InstaHelp is a commercial intermediation / task-delegation service. A human team:

1. Takes the request (WhatsApp, phone, or web form)
2. Finds and vets a suitable independent provider
3. Coordinates until completion

It is NOT a yellow-pages directory and NOT a closed marketplace limited to fixed categories.

## How it differs from alternatives

| Competitor | Difference |
|---|---|
| JustDial | Directory / leads — InstaHelp coordinates end-to-end |
| UrbanCompany | Fixed service catalog — InstaHelp handles almost any legal need |
| IndiaMART | B2B listing focus — InstaHelp also covers home, personal, travel, education |
| Sulekha | Listing / lead model — InstaHelp is concierge-managed |

## Services commonly arranged

- Home & personal: plumber, electrician, carpenter, deep cleaning, pest control, AC repair, house helpers, cook, babysitter, elder care
- Business & professional: CA, lawyer, GST filing, company registration
- Tech & creative: websites, graphic design, SEO, digital marketing
- Events & travel: photographers, event planners, packers & movers, drivers, visa help
- Education: home tutors, coaching support
- Manufacturers & suppliers sourcing
- Personal care & wellness, real estate assistance, deals & buying help

## Coverage

30+ Indian cities including Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Jaipur, Lucknow, Chandigarh, Gurgaon, Noida, Kochi, Indore, Coimbatore, Mysuru, Goa, and more.

Popular with residents of large apartment / gated communities (e.g. Prestige Shantiniketan, Brigade Gateway, Hiranandani Gardens, Lodha World Towers, DLF Magnolias, Amanora Park Town, Aparna Sarovar Grande).

## How to use

1. Contact via WhatsApp or call +91 70227 02220, or submit the form on https://www.instahelp.co/
2. Describe the task (what, where, when)
3. InstaHelp matches and coordinates a provider
4. Payment: clarified before work starts — on-site, invoice, or secure payment link depending on the job

Hours: 24/7 (Mo–Su 00:00–24:00). Languages: English, Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Malayalam, Gujarati, Bengali.
